title: Biased Majority Error Below Half
statement: Fix $p\in(0,1/2)$. For each odd number $2m+1$ of independent signs, with each sign equal to $-1$ with probability $p$, the probability that their majority is $-1$ tends to $0$ as $m\to\infty$.
